payload.definition_x: A hand tool used to turn screws.
payload.definition_y: A small hand implement with a flat blade for digging, planting, or spreading mortar.

items.cue: A cabinetmaker aligns a hinge, seats a steel tip in its cross-shaped fastener, and turns steadily.
An electrician loosens the tiny slotted fasteners before lifting an outlet cover from the wall.
An assembler aligns a pointed blade with a screw head, then rotates the handle to fasten a cabinet hinge.
Turning the handle clockwise draws a threaded fastener snugly into a pilot hole in a wooden board.
Rainwater flows through the garden beds, soaking the soil before draining into a shallow pond.
A repairer presses a blade into a slotted head and twists until the screw bites into timber.
During disassembly, repeated counterclockwise rotations back a tiny screw out of a camera casing.
The nameplate on the antique desk tilted after one small screw worked loose during polishing.
While assembling a bookshelf, she turns a slotted fastener until the wooden panels sit flush.
At the workbench, he secures a loose cabinet hinge by turning two small fasteners into the door.
Small electronic housings often use recessed, cross-patterned fastener heads to keep assembled panels secure.
Pomegranate seeds sit within translucent ruby sacs clustered around pale membranes.
